scenario: Two mountinfo lines share the mount point /data (an earlier xfs line whose super options end in noquota, a later tmpfs line whose super options carry usrquota): the duplicated covering mountpoint must be refused as an ambiguous overmount instead of being resolved by line order.

fixture.mountinfo:
1 23 0:21 / /proc rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec,relatime shared:12 - proc proc rw
7 23 0:6 / /dev rw,nosuid,relatime shared:2 - devtmpfs udev rw,size=4021252k,nr_inodes=1005313,mode=755
23 23 259:3 / / rw,relatime shared:1 - ext4 /dev/nvme0n1p3 rw,errors=remount-ro
31 23 259:2 / /data rw,relatime shared:1 - xfs /dev/nvme0n1p2 rw,inode64,logbufs=8,logbsize=256k,noquota
44 31 0:58 / /data rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec,relatime shared:1 - tmpfs tmpfs rw,size=4194304k,inode64,usrquota

rationale: Amendment, not the original contract, governs this corrected case. Mount resolution (preseal-amendment.md:50-54): 'Longest component-prefix selection remains. However if ANY covering mountpoint occurs more than once, refuse classification as unknown/n/a/ambiguous_overmount, fstype=null,mount_point=null, device_check=not_checked. Do not guess stack order from line order or reusable IDs.' The fixture keeps two mountinfo lines whose mount point is /data (mountinfo field 5, proc.rst:1977): mount ID 31 (xfs, super options 'rw,inode64,logbufs=8,logbsize=256k,noquota') and mount ID 44 (tmpfs, super options 'rw,size=4194304k,inode64,usrquota'). For the requested path /data (realpath /data, st_dev 0:58) the covering mountpoints are '/' (the ext4 root line, mount ID 23) and '/data', and '/data' occurs twice, so the duplicate-covering-mountpoint refusal applies and the path is not classified at all. The pre-amendment expectation (tmpfs / enabled / enforced / tmpfs_quota_option, exit 1 QUOTA_ENABLED, in cases-proposed/CaseStacked.json) is withdrawn: the amendment explicitly forbids using line order to pick a stack winner, so the earlier xfs/ later tmpfs ordering no longer decides the outcome, and neither line's super options are parsed for this path. Therefore fstype=null and mount_point=null (preseal-amendment.md:51-52, matching the no-cover convention at :58), quota_state=unknown, enforcement=n/a, basis=ambiguous_overmount, device_check=not_checked. Verdict: the original contract's precedence (contract.md:132-134) still applies - no setup error, no enabled path, one unknown path - so exit 2 and finding_id QUOTA_STATE_UNKNOWN. The classification table is never reached for this path, so the tmpfs row (contract.md:120), the xfs rows (contract.md:110-114) and the device-equality rule (contract.md:100-103, preseal-amendment.md:55-58) are all inapplicable here. Fixture deltas required by the amendment, all in the btrfs_sysfs block: the decoy UUID record '1d02a454-c549-4a35-b567-89d60902af8e' gains the required member qgroups_enabled (preseal-amendment.md:37-38); its original qgroups=false pairs with enabled=null/mode=null (preseal-amendment.md:39, :42-43), which is what the record already carries for qgroups_mode, so qgroups_enabled=null and qgroups_mode=null are the consistent values. The record is inert for this case - no mount in the fixture is btrfs, so the btrfs_qgroups_enabled / btrfs_qgroups_disabled / btrfs_qgroups_enabled_unavailable bases (preseal-amendment.md:39-43) are not exercised, and the decoy's presence with qgroups=false must not turn the path into a btrfs case. Everything else is preserved unchanged from the original proposal: the same five mountinfo lines, the same single path entry, the same device_links map; the mountinfo shape follows proc.rst section 3.5 (S082: heading 1965, example line 1970, field table 1973-1983 with mount point 1977, separator 1980, filesystem type 1981, mount source 1982, super options 1983), the xfs super options string follows xfs_fs_show_options (S078: xfs_super.c 186-190, quota options usrquota 239, uqnoenforce 241, prjquota 244, pqnoenforce 246, grpquota 249, gqnoenforce 251, noquota 254) and matches the frozen real observation in frozen/c2-expected-real.json, the tmpfs option vocabulary follows tmpfs.rst (S084: table header 129, quota 132, usrquota 135, grpquota 137, the four documented *_hardlimit rows 139-142) and the xfs option vocabulary follows xfs.rst (S077: noquota 171-173, uquota/usrquota/uqnoenforce/quota 175-177, gquota/grpquota/gqnoenforce 179-181, pquota/prjquota/pqnoenforce 183-185). No implementation, oracle or peer case was read for this correction; the derivation is from preseal-amendment.md, contract.md and the kernel sources only. Expected keys remain exactly the six scored fields (path, fstype, mount_point, quota_state, enforcement, basis); device_check (not_checked here), quota_option_keys and qgroups_mode are supplementary sealed checks under preseal-amendment.md:87-90 and are not asserted in this case file.
